english: The 'Gustave Kai'\nactivation device is around here, right?
Yes. Watch out for enemy ambushes.
It doesn't seem activated yet, though?
If they've already got the 'Angel's Tear',\nis the activation device still being calibrated, I wonder?
You've come. Let me welcome you.
That voice…!
Long time no see, Remu.
You!?\nI heard you escaped from Mie!?
Yes - Mie and Kei were using me\nas a vessel to seal away\nyour dream power.
So, now that you're free,\nwhat do you plan to do, I wonder?
Just as you suspect.\nI'll use 'Gustave Kai'\nto destroy the world.
You look just like me, yet\n you're doing the last thing I'd ever think of?
Not quite. I am you, you are me.\nYou could become me too.
Me, destroy the world? That's a bad joke!
You're mistaken.
Ah!!
Destruction is inevitable.
You stole the 'Angel's Tear' -\nyou're our fakes…!
We're not fakes…
Then what are you supposed to be?
They seem to differ from each other in various ways.\nThough the cause is unknown.
The 'Gustave Kai' I modified\nis mobile.\nDo you know what that means?
So it's free to move now -\nso what?
Freely… yes, freely.\nFor example, it means we could target\nIS Academy or Butei High.
What did you say!?
It can attack other worlds…?
'Gustave Kai' doesn't just destroy\ncities and land.\nIt destroys the very walls between worlds!
No way!? That can't be possible!
Remu, you'd understand, wouldn't you?\nThat it's possible.
…With dream power and the Polyal,\nplus the 'Angel's Tear' energy,\nit's not impossible…
N-no way…!
Why would you do something so terrible!
This world is better off destroyed.
Dream power exists to protect people's beautiful dreams!\nAbusing it to destroy the world -\nthat's wrong!
Dreams? Where are any dreams?\nWhat dreams do I protect?
Eh…?
The people's dreams I protected\nhave vanished.\nIn other words, my dream is gone.
There are people's dreams worth protecting in this world!\nDreams haven't vanished!
Protecting them is your job. Not mine.
What do you mean by that?
Enough chatter.\nEither way,\nyou and I can never coexist.
Show me you can protect\nyour precious 'people's dreams'!
Dream Hunter Remu!
This battle decides it.\nWill the world plunge into a final war\nwith 'Gustave Kai'…
…or will it be stopped here and lost…
Hehe, it's fun, isn't it? Remu.\nAfter all, we don't feel fear.
…I've never thought of battle\nas fun.\nThe mission to protect people's dreams is never light!
True… maybe I'm having fun\nbecause I lost that mission.
That makes you just like Doctor Shinigami!
Hmm, maybe so?
I won't accept it! I'll stop you here, no matter what!
We will never let you use 'Gustave Kai'!
We'll take back the 'Angel's Tear'!
…We absolutely won't lose!
Let's go, everyone!
Impostors are an outrage!
I lost… why…?
Just rampaging with brute force…\naren't they a bit too different\nto be called our fakes?
This wasn't supposed to happen…
Why do they seek battle?\nTwin Angels would never\ndo such a thing.
I don't accept this! This…
Right. There's no way\nthis unsightly thing is my fake!
Those girls alone weren't enough, as expected.
I am a single bullet…
Payback for earlier! Holes! Hoooles!!
It's them!!
You want a rematch?
Watch out for focused attacks!
This is tough… but!!
Let me shoot more! Let me slash more!\nThis world should just vanish!!\nA world without Mamaaaaah!!
She's strange… I can't believe\nher mama is anywhere in this world.\nWhere did she even come from…?
Burn to nothing!!\nThis world has no value!
No value…?\nWhy would you say that?
Remu, I'll steal your dreams.\nAnd you'll taste the same despair and die!
Can you really steal all my dreams, I wonder?\nI won't let you, anyway!
I see - right now you've regained your dream power\nand you're brimming with hope?
When you learn it's utterly useless,\nwhat will become of you, I wonder?
Mind your own business.\nI'll worry about the future after I win!
Why… our powers should be equal!
You named your own cause of defeat.\nThat you have no dreams.
I have so many dreams I want to protect.\nThat's strength - that carves open the future.\nHave you forgotten?
…The same cause of defeat as Doctor Shinigami.
But you too will lose your dreams someday…\nLike me…!
Thanks for the warning. I'm grateful.
You may be right -\nthat future might exist.\nBut I'll avoid it.
Because you taught me\nI must not become that.
Then defy fate.\nAnd despair.\n…I'll be waiting in hell.
…Hell, huh?\nI wonder if I can even go to hell?
We won… right?
Too early to let our guard down!\nWe need to find the 'Gustave Kai' activation device\nand take back the 'Angel's Tear'!
That won't be necessary.
Tesura-chan!
The 'Angel's Tear' is… here.
You'd already located it?
If you had it, say so sooner!\nNow, give it back to Aoi-oneesama…
…Sis.
I'll return this to the Amanotsukai.
Tesura-chan!
I even thought of just destroying it.\nBecause something like this exists, people try\nto fulfill their ambitions with destructive power.
But I also came to think it should be\nprotected as proof\nthat humans are good.
The 'Angel's Tear' should be held\nby you, whose duty it is to protect it.
…Agreed.
Tesura-san, Nain-san…
Yayy! What a relief!
Yes! Thank you so much,\nTesura-san, Nain-san.
Whew, now I can finally\nsleep soundly at night.
Huh? Kurumi-chan,\nhaven't you been sleeping well?
N-no! Um, well…\nyour sleep-talking was loud!
Huh!? I talk in my sleep!?
Yes, sometimes.
Hauu… I bet you've heard\nsomething embarrassingg…!
What are you babbling about!\nWe've already finished the job of\ndestroying the activation device we found!
Come now.\nWe achieved our goal, after all.
What about the original activation device\nat Black Fund HQ?
We'll take care of that one.
Promise…
Feels like everything got resolved at once!
It went a little too smoothly -\nkind of scary, desuu.
That black group seemed\nsomehow rushed in their actions.
True, it didn't seem like\na very meticulous plan?
Isn't that because they didn't expect\nMie and Kei to spill the beans?
That's probably one reason they panicked.
Put the other way, if we hadn't gotten info from Mie and the others,\n'Gustave Kai' would likely\nhave been fired?
Uwhya… good thing that didn't happen!
Reki, is something bothering you?
The black ones never revealed what they were,\nscattering with their mystery intact.\nThat bothers me.
It bothers me too. To be wiped out\nwithout ever revealing who they were…
When they vanished,\nI… felt sad.\nIs that weird?
Me too, Hibiki-san!\nWhy did they have to go that far?\nI wonder.
Me too!
Me too.
As for that, let's hope for info\nfrom the Hinamizawa and Gamers teams.
(What is it, [CLAUDE]?)
(No, just thinking - 'unknown identity'\nkind of sounds like me, hmm)
(You're not black, though)
(True, but…)
Then there's Mie and Kei's movements.\nNo telling what they'll do.
No rest for us yet.
So, how about one night in Dokoka Town?\nWe could rest up a bit there, right?
Agreed!
That looks like a clear majority.\nThen, let's do that!
//END
